You're in the supermarket when the announcement stops... mid-sentence.
The cashier stares at the door.
Someone is banging on the glass.
You grab the only thing near you. A baguette.
The automatic doors open. Close. Open.

text: Wait. Why isn't it coming in?

You see, every time it steps forward, the doors close in its face.
You back away slowly, into the frozen aisle.

text: Then a freezer door opens behind you... from the inside.
